Memory Allocation: Memory allocation uses a Page Table with the format:
size_t address: The literal Address of the memory block
size_t size: The literal size of the memory block
uint8_t [64] misc: A buffer of bytes containing miscallaenous data such as flags, decay and extra data
uint8_t buffer_len: the length of the data buffer, if it need to change
80 bytes each, pretty efficient
Features:
Allocation: An arbitrary pointer validates whether the the currently pointed RAM address is not used, starting from the ending pointer of the Program
and a Memory block at the end of RAM for the Kernel
For any edge cases where there isnt enough space, memory will be cached by the decay counter or the arbitrary pointer will simply be set to the lowest point in RAM
Re-Allocation: If there is enough space to simply extend the size the block, the size property of the Memory block is simply updated. Similarly when decrementing the Size of the Memory block
Otherwise the Memory data is moved to a more validated location
De-allocation(free): The header data for a Memory block is cleared
Back-end:
hcontext_store: Update or append header data into the page table
hcontext_directwrite: Directly write to a header's data buffer(using some conventions to de-complicate the process
hcontext_attrpeek: Read from an attribute in either the header's properties of data buffer
get_memsize: wrapper for hcontext_attrpeek that uses some presets
Necessities:
get_haddr: Convert a Memory block address into a Header block address
adress_validate: Check if an address overlaps with any header's memory block
space_validate: Check if a memory block at a specific address overlaps with any header's memory block
addr_pointfree: Take a preset address and increment till points to a valid address of specified size.
{return}; {true, true}: If the address was valid and of valid size.
{return}; {false, true}: If the address was invalid and of valid size.
{return}; {true, false}: If the address was valid and closely meets specified size but is slightly below.
{return}; {false, false}: If the address was invalid or of invalid size.
